description: flying forward through the air with no wings, the long body undulating in three gentle waves behind the head, head stretched forward facing the camera, front legs reaching forward with claws open, hind legs trailing back, whiskers streaming back, tail trailing at the end

name: 西方龙·收翼站立（基础）

names.ja: 西洋の竜・翼をたたんで立つ（基本）

description: standing on all four legs, the two wings folded tight against the sides of the body, neck raised in a gentle curve, head level facing forward, mouth closed, tail lying along the ground behind; each foot with four clawed toes; six limbs in total: four legs and two wings

name: 西方龙·展翼（基础）

names.ja: 西洋の竜・翼を広げる（基本）

description: standing on its two hind legs and leaning slightly forward with the two front legs held off the ground in front of the chest, both wings spread fully open and raised above the shoulders with the wing membranes stretched between four long finger bones each, neck raised, mouth closed, tail on the ground behind for balance

name: 独角兽·站立（基础）

names.ja: ユニコーン・立ち姿（基本）

description: standing calmly on all four legs, front legs straight, hind legs set back with the hocks angled backward, neck arched, head level, one straight spiralled horn in the middle of the forehead, mane falling on one side, tail hanging down

name: 独角兽·扬蹄（基础）

names.ja: ユニコーン・前足を上げる（基本）

description: rearing up on both hind legs with the hind hooves planted on the ground, body raised at about 60 degrees, both front legs lifted and folded at the knee in front of the chest, neck arched, head raised, one spiralled horn on the forehead, tail flowing down behind

name: 狮鹫·站立（基础）

names.ja: グリフォン・立ち姿（基本）

description: standing on all four legs, the two front legs feathered with eagle talons, the two hind legs furred with lion paws, two feathered wings half-folded and raised slightly from the back, eagle head level facing forward, hooked beak closed, lion tail curving behind

name: 麒麟·站立（基础）
description: standing calmly on all four slender legs with one front leg raised and bent at the knee, neck raised, head facing forward, one curved backswept horn, two whiskers, mane and tail flowing, no flames, no clouds

name: 神鸟·展翅（基础）

names.ja: 霊鳥・翼を広げる（基本）

description: hovering upright in the air with both wings spread wide to the sides and slightly raised, primaries splayed, both legs tucked under the body, long neck raised, head level facing forward, three crest plumes on the head, five long tail plumes trailing down in gentle curves; no fire, no glow
